This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on a monthly bases as indicated 
by M1 in the title block.

The first draft is initiated by eng. 
Nasser El Sayed A.Elaziz, tested by eng. Hassib Hussein Bahbouh, accepted by eng. Mohamed 
Osama Soliman general director, approved by eng. Mohamed A.Elbasset Rekaby head sector of Aswan 
Dam PS, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakim HPGC MPIS coordinator and inspection & quality control's general director.

 staff carry the suitable safety ID category

items:
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required

No 
 smoking is permitted in the battery room.

Use standard personal safety equipment as helmet, safety shoes, safety goggles, and 
 rubber gloves, and rubber apron.

Use 
 the proper insulated tools.

It is not permitted to place any tools on the top of the battery cells 
 avoiding short circuit.
It is not permitted to use the same tools on Lead-Acid battery before using on Alkaline battery and vice- versa.
Disconnect the power supply fuse.
Standard personal safety and healthy equipment

Brushes, distilled water, rags, safety goggles, rubber gloves 
 and rubber apron.
AVO meter

The 
 overall voltage of bank must be measured and recorded.

The battery charger must be switched off on 
 both sides.

All cells should be inspected for cracks and 
 leakage of electrolyte and the damaged cell(s) must be changed immediately.

Electrolyte level for all cells should be 
 inspected and if it is below the mark normal" distilled water should be 
 added providing that the electrolyte density is not affected.

The electrolyte density should be measured and 
 recorded for all cells.

The inter-cell connectors and terminals for all 
 cells should be inspected and cleaned from salt deposits using distilled water and 
 clean dry rags.

Terminal connections should be checked for 
 tightness.

Terminals and inter-cell connectors should be 
 lubricated with a thin film of Vaseline.
Top of cells should be cleaned.
Measure and record the voltage per cell.
Measure and record the density per cell.

Check the drop of voltage and density it should 
 be within the accepted range.

Compare the present readings with the 
 previous readings to decide the battery condition.

In case the battery is in good condition the 
 battery charger should be turned back to service.
